resolution_behavior.removes_comment: True - the task comment is removed from the element's comments array
resolution_behavior.audit_log: The removal is recorded as 'Task resolved' in the changelog
resolution_behavior.non_task_rejection: Attempting to resolve a non-task comment throws ValidationError
resolution_behavior.is_task_field: Must be exactly true (boolean), not just truthy

idempotency.description: Running the same action twice doesn't create duplicate comments or task comments
idempotency.method: Check existing comments for the same marker before creating
